title: Absence Care Credit — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
**Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement — absence care credit (the absence-relief credit).**

An absence-relief credit relieves part of the care fee for a temporary absence once the resident has returned or the residency has ended during the absence. It relates to the billing month of the most recent full-month care fee charge on the residency, references that charge, carries the absence start date and is posted at most once per absence per billing month. Once posted, the credit appears on the resident's statement for that month as an absence care credit, and the amount owed on the residency account goes down by the amount credited.

### Posting the credit

The credit is posted by the desk with the agent-side tool `post_absence_care_credit_bb749fc3`: the tool is first unlocked and then called by the agent. It writes exactly one absence care credit with the values supplied; it does not look anything up or work out the amount.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `assisted_residency_id` | Reference number of the assisted living residency whose account is credited, as returned by the assisted living residency lookup | Identifier |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the ledger entry of the care fee charge being relieved, as returned by the assisted living ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `absence_start_date` | The date the absence began, exactly as recorded on the residency | YYYY-MM-DD, the community's local calendar |
| `billing_period` | The billing month the credit relates to, for example the month of the care fee charge relieved | YYYY-MM |
| `amount` | The credit amount in US dollars, positive, already rounded to the cent; it is posted exactly as given | Number with 2 decimal places |

### Return

On success the tool returns `status` "posted", `entry_id` (the reference number of the new ledger credit), `assisted_residency_id` (the residency credited), `amount` (the USD amount credited, 2 decimal places) and `account_balance` (the residency balance in USD after the credit, 2 decimal places; a negative balance is a credit balance). The tool states no error return.

### Basis Q&A

**Which charge does the credit reference?** The most recent full-month care fee charge on the residency; the billing month entered is the billing month of that charge.

**Can the same absence be credited twice for one billing month?** No; the credit is posted at most once per absence per billing month.
